summary: Candidate is a distinct micro-skill for array sorting and reordering operations with clear semantic identity (sorting, permuting, shuffling) that does not overlap with existing skills. Peer candidates (Array Transform Operations, Natural Order Comparison, XML Namespace Resolution) are either in different task families (transform, comparison, xml_handling vs. sorting_permutation) or represent atomic sub-operations (Natural Order Comparison is a building block, not a replacement). Existing skills in registry are unrelated (reward computation, buffer timeout tuning). Support evidence from D3 API confirms this is a valid, documented capability. No conflicts detected.
